Commentary.Commentary: That is it from our side for this match. England have leveled the series with a thumping victory in the Mecca of cricket and set up a thrilling game for the third and final ODI of the series. We will see you again at 1230 local (1130 GMT) on Tuesday at Headingley, Leeds. However, the cricket continues around the globe for now. You can catch the action from the second Test match between Windies and Bangladesh just by switching tabs. Till then, ciao!

Man of the Match, Joe Root, says that it's similar for everyone as he believes the more time one spends in the middle the better they feel with their craft. Believes that the team has been playing a great brand of cricket throughout this summer. Praises the bowling effort as it was crucial to beat a team like India. Ends by saying that it is about learning from their mistakes in the T20Is and the first ODI and putting up a professional performance, which they did.

England captain, Eoin Morgan, says they learnt a lot from their mistakes in the previous game. Praises his batters, especially David Willey's innings at the end. Backs up his decision to bat first as it's his home ground and he knows the conditions better. Further asserts that Joe Root and his experience is immense, more so on sluggish pitches like these. Ends by saying that he believes if they continue to play the way they did today, they should win the next match at Leed's.

India captain, Virat Kohli, starts by saying that the pitch got slower in the second innings and adds that once you lose three wickets early, it gets difficult to chase a stiff target on such a wicket. Asserts that they like to test the character of the team and backs up the bowlers they played today. Praises the spin duo of Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid who he feels put them under pressure and didn't allow them to get runs. Defends MS Dhoni's innings and says that he is a match-winner and he will come good, if not today. Further adds that it was a bad day for most of their batsmen and believes that they will bounce back in the next match. Ends by saying that England is a good side and he expected them to bounce back after the loss.

India, on the other hand, had a decent start as Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan put up a 49-run partnership. Once the former threw his wicket away, two quick wickets pushed the them back. After that, Virat Kohli and Suresh Raina stitched a threatening 80-run stand but both got out at the wrong time. This put the batters coming in under pressure and made them play rash shots. The spin duo of Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid bowled superbly as they didn't allow the lower order to get runs. Liam Plunkett ran through the tail as India succumbed on the slower pitch. Earlier in the day, a fine ton from Joe Root and some good knocks from the others, especially David Willey, saw England post a total too good for the Indians.

That is it. England have leveled the series in a grand fashion. They have outplayed the Men in Blue at the Mecca of cricket and won emphatically. After a dominating performance with the bat, their bowlers put their hands up and went through the dangerous-looking batting line-up of the visitors. Liam Plunkett took a 4-fer, however, it was a win set up by all the bowlers. Everyone except Ben Stokes got into the wickets and made a mockery of the Indian chase.

OUT! And England have their revenge. They defeat India by a big margin and add salt to their wounds by bowling them out as well. Fuller on the stumps, Chahal looks to go big downtown but can only loft it as far as Ben Stokes at mid on, positioned at the edge of the circle. ENGLAND WIN BY 86 RUNS!
FOUR! Edged and away! Full and outside off, Chahal throws his bat at it and edges it through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Back of a length on the stumps, heaved away over the mid-wicket. Chahal clears the infield and comes back for the second.
Fullish in length and just outside off, Chahal drives it to the mid off fielder.
Full and swinging away from around off, driven straight to short cover.
Full outside off, Chahal drives it square through point and takes two for his effort.
Kuldeep has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes forward, gets behind the line and defends.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off on a good length, Kuldeep can't put any bat on it.
Pushes this one to the covers for nothing.
Sharp bumper from Plunkett, Kuldeep barely manages to duck and evade.

Comical stuff out in the middle. Chahal taps this towards backward point, sets off but seeing Moeen Ali diving and stopping the ball, he rushes to get back before the throw comes in. It misses, he tries to steal one now but another throw comes in from square leg and he has to dive back in again. Hilarious.

FOUR! A bright smile on Chahal's face. He raises his bat to his dressing room, probably happy he didn't get out for a duck. Full and straight, Chahal throws his front leg out of the way and smashes it straight back down the ground for a boundary.
Good length ball this time, pushed out tamely.
Comes half-forward to the length ball and defends it out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Fuller in length from Willey, blocked.
Full and angling in, catches Chahal low on the pads. Going down leg, so the umpire doesn't respond to the appeal.
FIVE WIDES! Strange. Seemed like there was some noise. Length delivery angling down, goes past the batsman and the keeper for a boundary.
Full delivery just outside off, pushed defensively in front of covers.
Yuzvendra Chahal is the last man in.

OUT! Second of the over, England one step close to victory. Taking the review was a mere formality. Length ball around off, it cuts back in and hits Siddarth Kaul on the pads. Flush in front of the stumps, loud appeal goes up and so does the finger. Kaul takes the review, but it doesn't help him. He's out of here.
An lbw decision against Siddarth Kaul is referred upstairs. Looks plumb...
Full ball fired outside off, Kuldeep opens the bat face and squeezes it past point for one.
Back of a length around off, tapped to backward point with an open face. Single taken.
Siddarth Kaul to bat now.

OUT! Dhoni holes out! He finally decides to go for it. Charges out to this length ball on the stumps and swings across the line. Hits it straight down Ben Stokes' throat at deep mid-wicket who makes no mistake in gobbling that up. England just 2 wickets away from victory now.
On middle, punched back to the bowler.
On off, punched to mid off. One run taken. APPLAUSE!
Wide! Down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Similar ball from Willey, Dhoni works it to gully. AGAIN no attempt to play the big shot.
Around off, pushed to covers again by MSD. He is taking his time for some reason.
Around off, cut through covers. Dhoni denies the single.
Short and wide, Dhoni looks to pulls but ends up getting an under edge on to the track.
Tucks it behind point for a run and keeps the strike for the next over.
Outside off again, Kuldeep edges but the ball doesn't carry to the slip fielder. A run taken from the fumble.
Outside off, Yadav misses the line of the ball.
Short in line of the stumps, Dhoni pulls it to square leg. One run taken.
Similar ball outside off, Dhoni is happy to tap it to point.
Back of a length ball, MSD defends it astonishingly, even at this stage.
Back of length around off, cut to point for a single.
Wide outside off, MS dabs it to gully.
On the pads, flicked fine for a run.
A short of a length ball outside off, Yadav pushes it to point for nothing.
A play and a miss to the length ball around off.
Yadav shoulders arms to let that one through.
David Willey is back on.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
WOW! Kuldeep Yadav chose to leave one when the equation reads 116 needed off 43. A length ball outside off, left alone by Yadav.
Similar line and length from Plunkett, Kuldeep misses it again.
Back of a length around off, Yadav misses the ball.
Chops the shortish ball to third man and runs a single. This is one crucial run as it takes him to 10,000 runs in the ODIs, 12th overall and 4th Indian to achieve it. Take a bow legend!
FOUR! Too little too late? Perhaps. A rare boundary through covers. A length ball outside off, he drives it on the up and gets a boundary.
Kuldeep defends it down the track. And with that, Adil Rashid is done with his spell. His figures read 10-0-38-2. What a display of leg spin bowling this has been.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wrong 'un on leg, pushed to mid-wicket for another one. This won't hurt the English bowlers.
Tossed up on the pads, Dhoni works it to fine leg and changes strike.
A touch short, MSD slaps it from the back foot straight down the ground. Stokes at long on puts in a desperate dive and is able to stop it inside the boundary. Good effort. Two runs taken.
Slower and floated in line of the stumps, Dhoni comes down the track but doesn't get it on the bat.
Wide outside off, pushed through the point region. One run taken and Dhoni keeps strike.
This one stays a touch low. A back of a length ball on middle, MS goes for the push but misses and gets hit on his pads.
Full on off, pushed through cover-point for a single.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire doesn't signal wide.
On the hips, clipped to fine leg for a single.
Dhoni just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball bowled by the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted on off and middle, MSD drives it to long on for another run.
A touch short in line of the stumps, flicked to the on side for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav is the next batsman in.

OUT! And he is gone for a duck. Another one bites the dust. A loopy delivery around off, Umesh Yadav goes for a big hoick but misses. Buttler whips the bails off quickly as Yadav drags his foot out of the crease. India falling deeper now.
Referral for stumping is taken upstairs.
Another flighted ball around off, Yadav goes for the push but misses.
Flighted on middle, pushed to mid-wicket for a run.
Umesh Yadav comes in next.

OUT! Unlucky for India and lucky for England. Pandya is gone. Plunkett gets a wicket courtesy Buttler's amazing reflexes. A length ball down the leg side, Pandya goes for the flick and gets a feather on it. Buttler dives to his left and completes another fine catch. India struggling at 191/6 now.
On the pads, flicked to fine leg for another run.
Just inside the tramline, Dhoni lets it pass. The umpire doesn't signal the wide.
Short and wide, slapped through cover-point for a brace.
A back of a length ball on off, Pandya guides it to third man. One run taken.
A full ball around off, whipped to the on side by Pandya.
Liam Plunkett is back on.
Around off, cut through cover-point for a run.
Dhoni gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it to the on side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A touch short and wide, cut straight to point.
Dhoni dances down the track and clips it to square leg. They manage to come back for the second.
Hangs back and punches the ball to mid-wicket for a run.
Looks to sweep the flighted ball around off but misses.
Dhoni comes rushing out of his crease to play the big shot but misses the ball. It hits him on his pad as Ali appeals. The umpire ignores it. Another good over from the spinner.
On the pads again, Pandya flicks it to square leg. One run to the total.
On the pads, easily guided to fine leg for a single.
MSD tucks it to mid-wicket for nothing.
A touch shorter, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Dismissed from his presence by Hardik. A flatter ball on middle and off, Pandya stays back in his crease and goes hard with the bat. The fielder from mid-wicket runs to his right but can't cut out the ball at square leg. A boundary results.
Drives the last ball to mid on and Rashid has bowled a very good over here.
Another loopy ball in line of the stumps, MSD defends it again. 5 dots in a row. Can Adil finish well?
Flatter around off, Dhoni happy to defend it.
Defended off the front foot by Dhoni presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets on the front foot and blocks it.
Slightly short around off, cut uppishly over point. One run results.

Reverse sweep now from Pandya. A straight ball outside off, Hardik goes for the reverse hit and gets it from the splice. Ali appeals as he believes it hit him on his pad first. As a reason, Morgan goes for the review. The replays suggests that the ball kissed the bat first and Pandya will continue.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Cleverly done by Pandya. He waits for the ball around off and cuts it late. He finds the gap through backward point. The fielder from deep extra cover runs in and saves a single for his team.
Touch shorter around off, Dhoni punches it off the back foot. One run taken.
Tossed up on off, MSD misses the ball and gets hit on his pad.

FOUR! And Dhoni on the charge straightaway. He comes out charging out of the crease to play the flatter delivery and thrashes it to the square leg boundary. They need to take control of the game and that's what Dhoni is looking to do.

Drinks break. Safe to say, India's last hopes lie with the current pair of Dhoni and Hardik. Usually you'd think Dhoni would hold one end and Hardik would attack, but given the asking rate, seems both would have to attack. Should be an intriguing finish either way.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They pick up a single.
Drives this fuller length leg break through to long off for a single.
Skidding off the surface as it's served on off, Hardik offers a firm punch to covers.
Stays back and keeps it out safely.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Landed on a bit of a shorter length, kept out on the off side.
Whips it away this time but straight to short mid-wicket. Another good over from Moeen, just 5 from it.
Dhoni has his dancing shoes on again. Comes out to work it on the leg side but takes it on the pads.
Gets close to the pitch of the ball and blocks.
Quick and straight well outside off, Hardik cuts it fine past short third man. The fielder there chases after it as the batsmen take three.
Dhoni takes a step out of the crease, adjusts his body and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flat and on middle and leg, punched down to long on for a single.
Drifting in on middle and leg, worked away through mid-wicket. One run to the scoreboard.
Flat, short and quick on the stumps, punched off the back foot to the left of the bowler.
Short and flat outside off, cut square on the off side for a run.
A lot of flight offered outside off, Dhoni with a big lunge forward keeps it out.
Hardik is off the mark immediately. Works it through long on and crosses over.
Hardik Pandya makes his way out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Couldn't resist the temptation. Lost his patience and is done in because of it. Looped up googly on middle and leg, it turns ever so slightly and that's enough to get Suresh Raina. He kneels down to wind up for the big slog sweep and goes through with it, but the ball goes right through the big gate. The furniture behind is disturbed and that's the other set batsman gone. He too falls short of a fifty. England on top now.
Pushed through the covers once more. Another run. Tight over from Moeen ends.
Skips down the track with the use of the feet and eases it to long on for one run.
Pushed through the vacant spaces in the cover region for a single.
Another dot. Flatter and around off, Raina can only force it on the off side.
Moves well across again and tucks it through backward square leg for a run.
Flights this up outside off, Dhoni leans across to sweeps but misses and it goes off his pads. Past the keeper and hence, two leg byes come.
Dhoni reaches out to this delivery outside off and plays it to point. Single added to the total.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Worked away with good use of the wrists through square leg. Single taken.
Darted full and fast around off, catches Raina low on the pads as he misses the flick.
Flipper from Rashid, Raina presses forward and blocks.
Straighter one on the stumps, blocked from within the crease.
Turns in, goes off Dhoni's pads who tries to work it across the line.
Dhoni gets to the pitch and blocks.
Flicks it to mid-wicket with the spin but finds the fielder there.
Full and outside off, turns in and catches Dhoni on the front pad who plants his front foot across to flick but misses.
Outside off, a punchy push to long off earns Suresh a run.
Full and fast on the stumps from around the wicket, Raina plays it back to Moeen.
Works it through square leg off the back foot and keeps strike.
Quick and flat on middle and leg, Raina is on the back foot before defending it down.
Dhoni gets off the mark with a little drive through mid off. Single taken.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Drifting in on leg, worked through short fine leg for a double.
Full and attacking the stumps, eased away to mid on.
MS Dhoni is the new man in for India.

OUT! Moeen Ali has struck gold. The Indian skipper and the king of chases Virat Kohli has been dismissed here. He falls just 5 short of his fifty. The off break from Moeen, it comes back in and catches Kohli dead in front of the stumps as he plays across the line and misses. Big appeal and the finger goes up quickly. No thought of the DRS from the skipper as he knows he's gone. Partnership of 80 comes to an end. Is this the moment England can capitalize on?
Worked to mid-wicket for nothing.

Dropped! Should have been taken. Roy is one of England's better fielders, you'd bet on him to take these. Tossed up outside off, Raina plants his front foot forward and drives it uppishly towards extra cover. Roy dives to his right, but drops what should have been a comfortable catch. One run collected.
Slower through the air, drifting in on off, Raina is forward as he pushes it back to the bowler.
Turning in from around off, cut late down to third man for a single.
Flat and short on the stumps, punched down to long on for a single. This Indian pair is doing well to rotate strike and keep the scoreboard ticking.
Extremely full on middle and leg, wristed through square leg. Single to the total.
VK has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Spinning into the left-hander, Raina goes with the spin as he turns it away through mid-wicket to get off strike.
Quite full and outside off, driven square through point for one more.
Flat and quick on the stumps, Raina uses the depth of the crease as he goes back and turns it to square leg for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Flicked away into the leg side off the pads. Single to end the over.
Good use of the feet from Raina. Jumps out of his crease to get close to the pitch and drives it through extra cover. Long off moves to his right to cut it off and the batsmen take two.
Outside off, cut away to point for one more.
Stays inside the crease and defends it off the back foot.
Raina goes down the ground too, but on the other side, to long off and takes one run.
Loopy off break on middle and off, Kohli uses his wrists as he works this down to long on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drives this full delivery through the gap in the covers and changes ends.
Leans ahead and knocks it through to long on for one.

Dropped! Tough chance but you've got to take those. And you expect someone like Buttler to take it. The googly on off, Raina doesn't pick it up and hangs his bat out to dry. Gets an edge which the keeper fails to collect. That was a big chance. Could it prove costly?
Pushes it through mid off for a single.
FOUR! He's welcomed into the attack with a boundary. Tossed up delivery outside off, Kohli stride ahead and caresses the drive through the covers for a boundary.
Comes forward and softly pushed it to the cover fielder.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On the stumps again, the batsman gets behind the line and defends.
A tad quicker through the air, in line of the stumps, blocked.
A risk free shot from Raina. Takes the aerial route but it's in a place where nobody is out in the deep. Just has to clear the infield which he does over extra cover and gets two for it.
Drifting in from around off, Raina is well forward in defense.
Another short one to Raina, another pulled helped but this time in front of square on the leg side. A run to end the over.
Easily done. Child's play for Virat Kohli as he opens the bat face and guides it to third man. One run taken.
Another bumper, very close to off, Suresh helps the pull to deep square leg for a single.
Short on off, rises a bit too much than expected. Kohli attempts to pull but mistimes it towards mid on as a result.
Stokes throws this fuller and wider outside off, Virat walks a step across and cuts it firmly, only to find the man at point.
Starts the over from around the wicket and angles a length ball into the hips, Raina hops and tucks it fine down the leg side. One run to the total.
Works it towards mid-wicket but it's straight to the fielder.
Pushed quicker through the air to Kohli, the Indian skipper defends from within the crease.
Spinning away from around off, Raina pushes it away into the covers for one.
Straighter one outside off, Kohli plays it towards point and takes a single for doing so.
Spinning in, it's worked towards mid-wicket.
Floated from around the wicket, Raina takes a big lunge forward and pushes it back past the bowler. The 50-run stand is up with this. So far, so good for India as far the rebuilding is concerned.
Plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.

Short of a good length, Kohli initially winds up for the ball but seeing the ball not rise as much, he adjusts and dabs it just wide of point. Takes off as Roy gets to the ball and fires a throw at the bowler's end. The Indian captain make it inside in time, but crashes into his counterpart while doing so. No harm done, both seem fine.
Full again, from around the wicket, Raina takes a step across his stumps and turns it square on the leg side. Gets to the other end with ease.
Full and wide outside off, helped down to third man for a single.
Stokes goes a little fuller this time, outside off, Kohli once again tries to have a feel for it but can't make any sort of connection.
Length delivery well outside off, Kohli throws his bat at it but fails to make any kind of connection. Bit rash from the Indian skipper.
Another front foot defense by the batsman to end the over.
Nice flight on this occasion, full and around off, Raina presses forward and smothers the ball in its tracks.
Around the wicket to Raina, it's tossed up, defended solidly by the left-hander.
Finds the gap this time. Manages to get it past the fielder for a single.
Plays with the turn and works it away to mid-wicket.
Tossed up off break on off, it turns in sharply and catches Kohli on the front pad who looks to defend. No appeal made, it was always going down leg.
Moeen Ali into the attack.
Raina's kryptonite showing there. Stokes brings out the short one and takes Raina by surprise. The southpaw rises and somehow awkwardly fends it away aerially on the leg side where it falls safely.
Little too straight in line, turned through backward square leg for an easy run.
Width offered outside off, Kohli is a bit uppish as he slices this. Wide enough of the man at point though, so no harm done as such. Two runs result.
Hits the deck hard once more, some extra bounce is extracted as it's served on a length around off, Kohli defends it down in front of covers.
Length ball, close to the off stick, Raina once again moves across his stick and clips it through backward square leg. Jogs over to the other end and completes the single.
Pounded on a short of a length, on middle and leg, Kohli with soft hands works it on the leg side and calls his partner through.
Full delivery on off stump, Kohli comes forward, leans across a bit and wrists it towards mid on. Takes a quick single as well.
Darts it in on the pads, Raina comfortably clips it behind square on the leg side. One run to the total.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
On a fullish length outside the line of off stump, Raina gets low and squeezes it out behind point. Easy two available which the batsmen take.
Waits for the length ball outside off to come to him before running it down to third man for one.
From over the wicket now, it's full and angled in on the pads, Kohli flicks it neatly behind square leg. Fine leg comes across to his left and cuts it off. The batsmen take two.
Comes from around the wicket and fires it full outside off, Raina reaches out to it and drives it along the ground to sweeper cover for a single.
Too wide outside off, Kohli goes fishing and gets an edge but it bounces before reaching Buttler behind the stumps.
Too full on leg, Raina does well to get bat on it. One run taken from the square leg region.
A teasing bouncer from Stokes, Kohli pulls it to fine leg for one.
Outside off, worked to third man for a single.
Raina just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball bowled by the bowler.
Cross seam delivery from Stokes in line of the stumps, Raina as usual moves across but misses the ball this time. Ben erupts in appeal but the umpire ignores it.
Drinks! India are into a rebuilding phase after a flurry of wickets. Can they get on top from here?
Kohli defends it from within the crease.
Plunkett goes around the wicket and serves a length ball. Raina works it through point for one.
Flicks the length ball to fine leg and takes a run.
Wide! The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Wrists away the fuller ball to fine leg and changes strike.
Slightly short and wide, Virat tucks it through the point region. One run taken.
A length ball around off, Kohli gets a bottom edge on that one and pushes it to the off side.
Fullish in line of the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Shows the full face of the and defends it.
Kohli opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. Two runs added to the total.

FOUR! Pure timing this. No fuss about it. A fullish ball outside off, Kohli gets a big stride out and checks his drive at the last moment. The timing is pure and as a result, the ball races away to the cover fence. He is so crucial for either team. If he stays, India celebrates, if he gets out England rejoice.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done by Raina. He has been looking to move across and play the deliveries to the on side. This time he gets a neat connection and finds the square leg fence for a boundary.
Ben Stokes is in into the attack.
On middle and leg, on a length, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket for two.
On a length in line of the stumps, Kohli misses to connect with the ball and gets hit high on his pad. The bowler appeals but Morgan denies the DRS.
Touch too straight from Liam, Raina tucks it to the leg side. One run taken.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket for another single.
Gets behind the line and blocks it to the off side. Single denied by Raina.
Driven through covers for a run by Raina.
In line of the stumps, worked to square leg for a run.
Full on off, driven down the ground by Kohli for a run.
Wide! Down the leg side, Kohli looks to flick but misses. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Bumper! Virat lets it be.
Around off, cut to point by Kohli.
In line of the stumps, worked though mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, under edged by Raina but the ball misses the stumps.
Full on leg, worked to the leg side by Raina for a single.

OUT! Amazing reflexes, what a catch from Buttler. India lose another. A back of a length ball outside off, the ball pitches and swings in just a touch. KL cuts it but gets a faint under edge. Buttler behind the stumps dives to his left, sticks out his left hand and takes a superb catch to send Rahul packing. What a start from England. Also, Suresh Raina is the next man in.
KL shoulders arms to let that one through.
On middle and leg, Kohli wrists it away to the on side for a single.
On a length in line of the stumps, Kohli blocks it out.
On a length outside off, Kohli drives it through covers and takes a brace.
Liam Plunkett is into the attack. While KL Rahul makes his way out to the middle for India.

OUT! Gone! Willey strikes. A fullish ball around off, Dhawan cuts it uppishly but hits it straight to Stokes at backward point who takes a simple catch. India two down in two overs. They did well here, England. It's a known fact Dhawan likes to cut, so they put their best fielder in the place where the ball is most likely to come. Good captaincy from Morgan.
Dhawan defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Willey errs in line again and Dhawan makes him pay. A fuller ball on the pads, Dhawan flicks it and gets it to the square leg boundary.
It's been driven superbly through the covers by Shikhar for nothing.
A back of a length ball on middle and off, defended by Dhawan.
Full outside off from Willey, Kohli guides it to third man. One run taken.
On a length around off, Kohli tucks it to mid-wicket and keeps the strike. End of a successful over for Wood.
On the pads, worked to the on side for another single.
Fullish around off, Kohli defends it but is aware of the opportunity there. He completes a quick single.
In line of the stumps, kept out down the track.
Virat Kohli strides out to bat.

OUT! And that's how you throw your wicket away. So much class, elegance, timing but fails to be patient. Clever from Wood who rolls his fingers and keeps it in line of the stumps. Rohit looks to play it over the on side and makes some room for himself but misses the ball. As a result, the ball crashes into his stumps. England have a breakthrough, and a big one too. The centurion from the last game departs early.
Full on off, driven straight to the bowler who gets a hand to it.
In line of the stumps, kept out by Dhawan.
Outside off, Rohit waits for the ball and guides it to third man for another single.
Hangs back and works the shortish ball to the on side for a run.
Caressed to mid-wicket uppishly by Rohit. One run taken.
On a length in line of the stumps, driven back past the bowler. Single taken.
On the pads, flicked to short fine leg for nothing.
On off, defended off the front foot by Sharma.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Edgy but effective. Just fractionally short in length from Wood, Rohit pulls it through square leg and earns a boundary.

Oh my word! You don't see Morgan do this often but there's always a first. A back of a length ball on middle and leg, Dhawan punches it through mid-wicket. Morgan there hares after it and gets into a tangle. As a result, three runs are taken.
FOUR! Pulled away this time. A short ball on middle, Dhawan gets into position quickly and times the pull ever so gracefully. A boundary results through the square leg region.
Fractionally short from Wood, Dhawan pulls it straight to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Gets behind the line and defends it down the track.
On the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Dhawan shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Bombastic! A mere punch this and the timing does the rest. A back of a length ball around off, Dhawan gets on his toes and finds the gap through cover-point. A boundary results.
Full on off, driven to mid off for nothing.
Rohit opens the face of the bat and guides the shortish ball behind point and changes strike.
On a length, driven to cover for nothing.
The batsman has played the square drive.

FOUR! Bang! What. A. Shot! Exquisite timing from Dhawan once again. A juicy half volley around off, Dhawan gets on the front foot and creams the cover drive to perfection. Third booming drive and second boundary from it.
On a length around off, Dhawan goes for another drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes towards fine leg and two runs are taken.
Jonny Bairstow is out of the field and Dawid Malan comes in to replace him.

Second exotic looking drive from Dhawan. Bairstow sacrifices his right hand to save a boundary for his team. Dhawan gets behind the line of the fullish ball and goes through the line. Bairstow at short cover sticks his right hand out, which is already taped, and stops the ball in its tracks.
FOUR! Power and elegance, says Sunil Gavaskar on air. A fullish ball outside off, Dhawan creams the drive through cover-point. No fielder moves which should tell you about the timing on it.
Fullish ball outside off, tapped to point by Rohit.
Wide! Willey is missing his length here. The ball is down the leg side but Rohit still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Driven to covers on the up for nothing.
Hangs back and defends it off the back foot.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
On a length in line of the stumps, Sharma keeps it out off the back foot.
Full around off, driven to covers for no run.
Rohit shoulders arms to let that one through.
Short, pulled to square leg for another single.
The ball meeting his bat is making a cracking sound, which shows more about Dhawan's form than anything else. A length ball on off, Dhawan drives to covers for a run.
On the pads this time, Dhawan flicks it to square leg and takes two.
Outside off, pushed to covers for nothing.
Back of a length on middle and off, Rohit fails to make contact with the ball cleanly and gets an inside edge on the pads. Dhawan calls for a quick single and a run is taken.
On a length in line of the stumps, defended from the crease by Rohit.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
FOUR! Shot! Beautiful. Left-hander's elegance. A full ball outside off, Dhawan reaches it and crashes it through covers for his first boundary.
Dhawan shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside off, left alone.
Similar line and length, Rohit works it to short fine leg and changes strike.
FOUR! Not the start Willey was looking for. Strays on the pads and all Rohit has to do is guide behind for a boundary. First for the visitors.
David Willey to share the new ball.
On the hips, guided to fine leg by Rohit. First runs off the bat.
Wide! Sharma tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Around off, the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Drags his length a touch and targets the ribs. Sharma is happy to block it.
On the off pole, fuller in length, kept out by Rohit. 3 dots to start with.
Similar ball, almost edges this one.
Starts with a length ball outside off, left alone by Rohit.
And we're all set. Both sets of players have made their way to the middle. Rohit Sharma along with Shikhar Dhawan takes his place. Mark Wood takes the new ball for England. Here we go...
